en: A sepia-toned postcard view of a calm river or pond with an overgrown small island in the foreground and dense trees along the bank. In the background on the right stands a large, simple rectangular building with a gabled roof, resembling a manor house or estate, partly obscured by trees. The sky is cloudy and tree branches frame the upper edges of the image. The word "CESVAINE." is printed in bold capital letters at the top center.
